title: Reuse transport evidence without replaying uncertain paid calls
when: Choosing a model/endpoint from historical routing records.
do: Read exact endpoint/model/input-contract evidence and current native capability state.
Use deterministic code for hashes, schema, geometry and bookkeeping.
Treat absent original receipt/cost as unknown; preserve liabilities.
check: Transport success is distinct from source interpretation quality or current authentication.
limitation: Historical Box response did not apply through the candidate-ID native port; offline qualification is not live admission.
